nodes.description: msg.sender: caller-controlled address used as balance owner, spender, allowance owner and owner-check subject.
block.timestamp: miner-influenced time value used for vesting start, cliff and vested amount computation.
Ownable.owner: privileged address that gates onlyOwner functions and receives revoked tokens.
BasicToken.balances: mapping(address => uint256) of token balances.
BasicToken.totalSupply_: total token supply, reduced on burn.
StandardToken.allowed: nested mapping of allowances used by transferFrom/burnFrom/approve.
TokenPool.token: ERC20Basic token managed by the pool, set once via setToken.
StandbyGamePool.currentVersion: address used as the delegatecall target in the fallback.
StandbyGamePool.ready: flag gating the fallback delegatecall path.
TokenVesting.beneficiary: recipient of released vested tokens.
TokenVesting.released: mapping tracking already released tokens per token contract.
TokenVesting.revoked: mapping marking a token as revoked, unlocking the full balance.
TeamPool.cache: mapping(address => TokenVesting[]) of vesting contracts per beneficiary.
BasicToken.transfer(address,uint256): moves tokens between balances using SafeMath.
StandardToken.transferFrom(address,address,uint256): allowance-based transfer.
StandardToken.approve(address,uint256): writes allowance for msg.sender; classic approve race condition.
BurnableToken.burn(uint256): public burn entry point, burns msg.sender's tokens.
BurnableToken._burn(address,uint256): internal balance and totalSupply_ deduction.
StandardBurnableToken.burnFrom(address,uint256): burns from another account using allowance.
Ownable.onlyOwner modifier: require(msg.sender == owner); the central access-control gate.
Ownable.transferOwnership(address): owner-only ownership handover.
Ownable.renounceOwnership(): owner-only renouncement, sets owner to address(0).
TokenPool.setToken(ERC20Basic): public one-time token initialiser with no access control.
TokenPool.transferTo(address,uint256): internal wrapper performing the external token.transfer call.
StandbyGamePool.update(address): owner-only, one-shot, sets ready and an arbitrary delegatecall target.
StandbyGamePool fallback: payable, requires ready, then delegatecall(msg.data) into currentVersion.
AdvisorPool.addVestor: owner-only creation of a TokenVesting starting at block.timestamp.
TokenVesting.release(ERC20Basic): computes unreleased amount and transfers it to the beneficiary.
TokenVesting.revoke(ERC20Basic): owner-only revocation returning unvested tokens to owner.
TokenVesting.releasableAmount: vestedAmount minus already released amount.
TokenVesting.vestedAmount: linear vesting math driven by block.timestamp, cliff, start and duration.
TeamPool.addVestor: owner-only public wrapper around _addVestor with revokable=true.
TeamPool._addVestor: creates a TokenVesting at block.timestamp, caches it and funds it.
TeamPool.vestingCount(address): returns cache length for a beneficiary.
TeamPool.revoke(address,uint): owner-only, indexes cache and calls TokenVesting.revoke.
BenzeneToken constructor: mints pool balances, stores pool addresses and wires pools to this token.
BasicToken.balanceOf(address): read-only balance lookup.
unsafe_operation: delegatecall(currentVersion, msg.data) executes arbitrary untrusted code in this contract's storage context.
unsafe_operation: SafeERC20 safeTransfer external call to the vesting token contract.
unsafe_operation: token.transfer external call performed by TokenPool.transferTo.
unsafe_operation: unchecked arithmetic, notably cache[_beneficiary].length - 1 and SafeMath sub/add/mul on balances.
Parameter _value of BasicToken.transfer: amount to debit.
Parameter _to of BasicToken.transfer: destination address.
Parameter newAddress of StandbyGamePool.update: becomes the delegatecall target.
Parameter _beneficiary of AdvisorPool.addVestor: recipient of the created vesting.
Local start in addVestor: assigned from block.timestamp and passed to the TokenVesting constructor.
Local unreleased in TokenVesting.release: amount to be paid out and recorded.
Local refund in TokenVesting.revoke: balance minus unreleased, returned to owner.

edges.reason: msg.sender is the account whose balance is debited in BasicToken.transfer.
msg.sender is used as the spender key when checking allowed[_from][msg.sender].
approve writes the allowance of msg.sender, enabling the classic allowance race.
burnFrom checks the allowance granted by msg.sender.
onlyOwner compares the untrusted msg.sender against the stored owner.
block.timestamp determines the vesting start in AdvisorPool.addVestor.
block.timestamp decides the vested amount and cliff/period branches.
block.timestamp determines the vesting start in TeamPool._addVestor.
Local start is assigned directly from block.timestamp.
onlyOwner reads the owner state variable for the authorization check.
transferOwnership overwrites the owner state variable.
renounceOwnership clears the owner state variable.
revoke sends the refund to the privileged owner address.
update requires ready == false before executing.
The fallback requires ready == true before delegatecalling.
onlyOwner gates transferOwnership.
onlyOwner gates renounceOwnership.
onlyOwner gates the one-shot update that chooses the delegatecall target.
onlyOwner gates AdvisorPool.addVestor.
onlyOwner gates TokenVesting.revoke.
onlyOwner gates TeamPool.addVestor.
onlyOwner gates TeamPool.revoke.
newAddress parameter flows into the stored delegatecall target.
update stores an attacker-chosen address into currentVersion used for delegatecall.
update flips the ready flag, enabling the fallback path.
update drains the pool balance through transferTo.
currentVersion is the target contract of the delegatecall.
fallback delegatecalls arbitrary msg.data into currentVersion, executing untrusted code with this contract's storage.
The pool token contract is the receiver of the external transfer call.
transferTo performs the external token.transfer call.
burn delegates to internal _burn.
burn passes msg.sender as the burner.
_burn reduces the burner balance in the balances mapping.
_burn reduces totalSupply_.
Balance deduction relies on SafeMath.sub arithmetic.
burnFrom delegates the actual burn to _burn.
burnFrom decrements the allowed mapping.
_value parameter determines the transferred amount in transfer.
_to parameter is the credit destination in transfer.
transfer writes debited and credited entries into balances.
transferFrom moves balances from _from to _to.
transferFrom decrements the spender allowance in allowed.
approve writes the allowed mapping for msg.sender.
setToken initialises the pool token without an owner check, so the first caller can front-run pool wiring.
transferTo reads the token state variable to build the external call.
AdvisorPool.addVestor funds the new vesting contract through transferTo.
_beneficiary parameter is embedded into the newly created TokenVesting.
addVestor assigns block.timestamp into the local start variable.
release obtains the unreleased amount from releasableAmount.
release performs an external token transfer before all bookkeeping is finalised, allowing a malicious token/beneficiary to re-enter.
release records the paid amount in the released mapping.
The beneficiary state variable is the recipient of the external transfer in release.
Local unreleased is added to the released mapping.
Local unreleased amount is the value pushed out through the external safeTransfer call.
revoke calls releasableAmount to compute the vested portion.
revoke sets the revoked flag for the token.
revoke performs an external token transfer to the owner with state changes not fully finalised.
Local refund value is sent out via the external safeTransfer call.
releasableAmount derives from vestedAmount.
releasableAmount subtracts the already released amount.
vestedAmount reads released to compute the total balance.
vestedAmount reads the revoked flag to shortcut to the full balance.
TeamPool.addVestor delegates to _addVestor.
_addVestor pushes the new TokenVesting into the cache mapping.
newIndex is computed with a raw unchecked length - 1 subtraction.
_addVestor funds the cached vesting contract through transferTo.
vestingCount reads cache length.
TeamPool.revoke calls TokenVesting.revoke on the cached contract.
TeamPool.revoke selects the vesting contract from the cache mapping.
The constructor seeds pool balances in the balances mapping.
The constructor sets totalSupply_ to INITIAL_SUPPLY.
The constructor calls setToken on the game, team and advisor pools.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
totalSupply_ is reduced when tokens are burned.

normalization_plan.reason: The _value parameter is only meaningful as the amount consumed by BasicToken.transfer and should be folded into that function node.
The _to parameter is only used as the credit destination inside BasicToken.transfer.
newAddress only exists to be stored into currentVersion by StandbyGamePool.update and should be merged into that function/unsafe delegatecall path.
_beneficiary is only consumed by AdvisorPool.addVestor when constructing the TokenVesting.
The start local is a temporary copy of block.timestamp used solely during vesting creation and adds no separate semantic entity.
unreleased is a transient value inside TokenVesting.release and should be folded into that function's unsafe external transfer path.
refund is a transient value inside TokenVesting.revoke and should be folded into that function's external transfer path.
